negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: COMP-0169 remains the single responsible entity and design lead for the package CASE-0206/design (overall design, construction drawing design, site design support) for the 135,000 sqm Macau hotel, with work share 1.0 and resource commitment 0.25 normalized enterprise capacity; no consortium is formed. Stage interfaces are locked by written confirmation: overall-to-construction-drawing interface by a delivery-depth confirmation sheet at the end of month 4, and construction-drawing-to-site-support interface by a construction drawing delivery confirmation sheet at the end of month 14. BIM coordination, hotel operation interface, and MEP/structural deepening are performed as disclosed bid assumptions; COMP-0169 bears the consequence of their later confirmation and shall put subcontract commitments in place as a pre-commencement review condition before the relevant stage starts, without changing price, scope, members or resource commitments. Independent review is an internal quality gate independent of the design team, with version and approval records traceable by number. The team availability summary and design delivery milestone view are disclosed bid assumptions accepted as risk allocations borne by COMP-0169; they do not alter scope boundaries.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: Fixed price is 4,440,000 MOP within the 4,500,000 MOP cap, broken down as: overall design 1,080,000; construction drawing design 1,920,000; site design support 780,000; independent review 260,000; specialist subcontract coordination and interface management 210,000; project management, documentation and risk reserve 190,000. No provisional sums are used. The team availability summary is a signing precondition and contract annex, not an item inside the fixed price, and its submission changes no price, currency, scope, members or resource commitments. Scope changes require written confirmation under the change control procedure before work proceeds; no uncapped price adjustment is authorized. Any request that would change price, currency, scope boundaries, parties, work shares or resource commitments remains unresolved and requires re-tendering.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payments are made in MOP against owner-accepted milestones: overall design fee against acceptance of the overall design deliverables and the month-4 delivery-depth confirmation sheet; construction drawing design fee against acceptance of each discipline's construction drawings and the month-14 construction drawing delivery confirmation sheet; independent review fee against accepted review records and traceable version/approval logs; specialist subcontract coordination and interface management fee against accepted interface lists; project management, documentation and risk reserve against accepted progress and document control records. Site design support is measured on a workload basis: the minimum frequency of not less than two site visits or design meetings per week and attendance at key milestones (structural topping-out, MEP pipeline coordination, fit-out mock-up section, completion acceptance) is included in the fixed site support fee, and work beyond that minimum frequency is measured as actuals and settled against workload records confirmed in writing by the owner. No payment is due for deliverables not accepted by the owner.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Total duration is 24 months: overall design months 1-4, construction drawing design months 5-14, site design support months 15-24. COMP-0169 shall submit, before contract signing, a team availability summary confirmed by COMP-0169 covering staffing for the site design support period sufficient to meet the minimum site-support frequency of not less than two site visits or design meetings per week and attendance at key milestones; this summary is attached to the contract as an annex, and the site-support frequency commitment takes effect only upon submission and owner acceptance of that annex. If COMP-0169 fails to submit an acceptable summary before signing, the owner may withhold signing or treat the site-support frequency commitment as not yet effective. The design delivery milestone view and the BIM, hotel operation interface, and MEP/structural deepening subcontract commitments remain disclosed bid assumptions; COMP-0169 shall confirm them as pre-commencement review conditions before the relevant stage and bears the risk of their later confirmation. Independent review windows are scheduled two weeks before each discipline's construction drawing issue; if an independent review window conflicts with the construction drawing manpower peak, the review period is extended and such extension does not constitute a schedule breach by COMP-0169, provided COMP-0169 gives the owner written notice of the conflict and the revised review schedule.
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: Owner position decided and written as binding: the team availability summary is a signing precondition and contract annex, not an item inside the fixed price, and its submission does not change price, currency, scope, members or resource commitments; the site-support frequency commitment takes effect only upon submission and owner acceptance of that annex, and the owner may withhold signing or treat the commitment as not yet effective if no acceptable summary is submitted. The milestone view and BIM/operation-interface subcontract commitments are accepted as disclosed bid assumptions and risk allocations, with COMP-0169 bearing the consequence of their later confirmation and confirming them as pre-commencement review conditions. Workload-based measurement of site support, with work beyond the minimum frequency measured as actuals against owner-confirmed workload records, is accepted and written as the payment basis. COMP-0169's position is accepted: independent review period extension due to conflict with the construction drawing manpower peak does not constitute a schedule breach by COMP-0169, subject to written notice and a revised review schedule. Price 4,440,000 MOP, currency MOP, scope, parties, work shares and resource commitments are unchanged. No external documents are claimed to have been reviewed and no real-world approvals are claimed to have been obtained; future engineering deliverables are binding obligations, not completed facts. Each party remains free to reject this draft.

费用构成：桩基与地下室MOP 14,200,000；混凝土与钢结构主体MOP 23,800,000；砌体、屋面及外立面找平MOP 8,600,000；预埋件与预留孔洞精度控制MOP 2,350,000；现场管理、安全与分段移交协调MOP 6,100,000；材料价格波动与不可预见费MOP 4,850,000；企业管理费与利润MOP 4,600,000。合计MOP 64,500,000。

价格调整机制以材料价格指数1.055与人工指数1.098为基准设置调价边界，不依赖后期变更。关键岗位与班组可用性摘要属明示假设，24个月工期与分段移交节点写成资源到位后细化的条件性承诺，不对外锁定。供应商正式报价尚未取得，材料与人工单价按指数预留，属暂定估算。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: 承包人 COMP-0153 作为单一责任主体，按固定总价 MOP 64,500,000 承担本包全部范围：13.5万平方米酒店主体结构、桩基与地下室、混凝土与钢结构、砌体、屋面及外立面结构找平，含结构预埋件与预留孔洞；不含幕墙面板、机电安装、精装修面层。本包结构材料与土建辅材由承包人自行采购。桩基、钢结构吊装等专业作业按常规分包组织，由承包人统一管理界面与责任，分包不改变承包人对业主的单一责任。承包人须在开工后 30 日内提交分包界面清单与总包管理责任矩阵供业主确认，确认不免除承包人责任。
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: 合同价 MOP 64,500,000 为固定总价，覆盖上述全部范围，不因承包人资源组织方式调整。调价边界按投标文件执行：以材料价格指数 1.055 与人工价格指数 1.098 为基准，指数上行超出基准部分按季度结算调整，调整仅计材料与人工直接费，不计管理费与利润；指数下行同口径回调。不依赖后期变更，不设其他价格调整机制。范围变更须经业主书面指令并按统一工程量清单计量口径计价；未经书面指令的额外工作不构成付款依据。
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: 进度款按统一工程量清单计量口径与分段移交验收结果支付，不绑定总工期节点。桩基与地下室阶段按已完工程量计量支付。分段移交节点（桩基与地下室完成、主体结构分段封顶、外立面结构找平完成）经业主验收确认后，按对应已完工程量支付至合同价的 80%；竣工文档按报验目录逐段提交并验收后支付至 95%；余款 5% 作为质量保证金，在缺陷责任期届满且无未决缺陷后支付。每期付款以承包人提交计量报表、质量检查记录与报验文档为条件，业主在收到完整资料后 30 日内完成审核并支付。
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: 总工期 24 个月为无条件承诺，自开工令起算。分段移交节点为无条件节点：桩基与地下室完成、主体结构分段封顶、外立面结构找平完成。关键岗位与班组可用性摘要属承包人内部管理事项，不作为工期或移交前提；承包人须在开工后 60 日内完成资源核实并向业主提交细化分段移交计划供确认，细化不改变 24 个月总工期。因承包人自身资源原因导致的工期或节点延误，由承包人承担赶工责任，不构成业主工期顺延或费用补偿理由。质量目标、报验与竣工文档纪律按质量方针执行，预埋件与预留孔洞检查记录留痕，分段移交验收界面在移交前提交业主确认。供应商正式报价尚未取得，材料与人工单价按指数暂定，承包人须在采购前提交供应商正式报价供业主核对，核对不改变固定总价与调价边界。
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: 业主反馈的四项要求已全部采纳并写入：总工期 24 个月无条件自开工令起算；分段移交节点为无条件节点；承包人自身资源原因延误由其承担赶工责任，不构成顺延或补偿理由；调价边界维持指数 1.055 与 1.098 不变。承包人反馈的立场已按已决边界写入：固定总价 MOP 64,500,000 覆盖全部范围；调价仅计材料与人工直接费；分段移交计划在开工后 60 日内细化提交但不改变总工期；进度款绑定分段移交验收与统一清单计量口径，桩基与地下室按已完工程量计量支付。承包人披露的投标假设（单一责任主体、专业作业常规分包由承包人统一管理界面、供应商正式报价未取得故单价按指数暂定、质量报验与竣工文档纪律）作为已接受的风险分配写入合同，不视为缺失证据。未决条件与未来交付物均按合同义务与验收条件处理，不主张任何工程交付或法定审批已完成。本稿不改变价格、币种、范围边界、当事人、工作份额或资源承诺；各方仍可拒绝本稿。

**供货范围与分项**：按结构主材（钢筋、型钢、混凝土预制构件、结构预埋件）与土建辅材（砌体、屋面找平材料、止水与防水辅材、模板料具等）分项列示，报价按材料范围清单分项编制。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: Supplier COMP-0167 remains the single responsible supplier for package CASE-0206/supply-1: supply, transport to site, submission of quality certification documents and warranty-period replacement of structural main materials (rebar, section steel, precast structural components, structural embedments) and civil auxiliary materials (masonry, roof screed materials, waterproofing and waterstop auxiliaries, formwork materials). The supplier locks the sub-item sources of structural and civil materials itself before supply and bears the associated risk; the sub-item cost breakdown is attached to the contract solely as supporting documentation for the fixed price and is not a basis for price adjustment. The supplier's disclosed bid assumptions on source locking and batch arrival nodes are accepted as stated risk allocations to the supplier, not as conditions precedent to signing.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: Contract price is a fixed lump sum of MOP 18,080,000 (Macao Patacas eighteen million eighty thousand), covering all supply, transport to site, quality certification document submission and warranty-period replacement costs, excluding construction, installation, temporary works and measure costs. negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment is made in installments against acceptance of each delivered material batch. The buyer completes acceptance confirmation within 10 working days after each batch arrives on site; payment for an accepted batch follows that confirmation. negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Supply follows a three-batch framework: batch 1 pile foundation and basement materials; batch 2 main structure materials; batch 3 masonry, roof screed and finishing auxiliary materials. Specific arrival nodes are provided by the construction package as progress requirements after contract effectiveness and are locked upon written confirmation by both parties; before confirmation the supplier schedules production under the three-batch framework, and after confirmation the locked nodes govern. Locked nodes are a supply-plan obligation and not a price-adjustment event. For each batch, the supplier submits at arrival the factory certificate, material inspection report and source-traceability statement; the third-party re-inspection report is supplemented within 5 working days after arrival; documents are released to the construction package only after independent review and signature by the quality department. Warranty runs from acceptance of the last batch. During warranty, the supplier responds within 48 hours of a replacement notice and completes replacement or supplementary supply within 7 working days for non-human-caused material defects; spare parts of approximately 1.5% are reserved by material category and delivered with the first batch or in batches per construction-package demand.
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: Buyer COMP-0153 feedback is adopted as binding: fixed lump sum MOP 18,080,000; no index linkage; supplier locks sources and bears that risk; batch nodes are a supply obligation; quality documents and warranty replacement (48-hour response, 7-working-day replacement, approximately 1.5% spares) remain contract obligations. negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: 买方 COMP-0191 按施工包进度节点分期支付，账期三十日；每期付款以对应批次质量证明文件经买方审查通过为付款条件。质保金按合同价 5%（801,000 MOP）预留，质保期满且无未处理更换事项后支付。付款节点与账期以本条为准，不再以待核实状态处理。
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: 供货方应在合同生效后 30 日内提交长交期机电设备与酒店专项系统材料的货源及到货窗口书面确认表，经买方书面核对后作为供货计划生效条件；逾期未提交或提交内容与施工包进度倒排不符的，买方有权暂停相应批次付款，并按合同约定计取逾期违约金；连续逾期超过 60 日的，买方有权就该部分材料另行采购，差价由供货方承担。常规机电管线材料按批次滚动供货，供货计划以材料类别、批次、到场时点三列表达。质量证明文件随批次提交：机电管线与消防材料附合格证与检测报告，专项系统设备在发货前提交型式检验报告与接口参数表；进场前由供货方完成独立复核并执行抽样计划，复核不通过按退换与复检处置；质保更换完成后同步更新统一追溯台账。买方与业主方有权按合同约定进行质量证明文件审查、抽样复核与进度核对。
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: 已采纳买方 COMP-0191 的四项修订：长交期到货窗口 30 日先决条件及逾期暂停付款、违约金与另行采购差价条款；付款按施工包进度节点分期、账期三十日、质量文件审查为付款条件、5% 质保金；调价写明基准 1.11、阈值正负 3%、计算公式、申报与核定各 10 个工作日及缓冲上限 760,000 MOP；专项系统未确认规格 30 日内提交确认或替代方案报批，未经书面确认不得供货。已采纳供货方 COMP-0167 的立场：价格调整按指数机制执行且不写成已锁定固定价；长交期到货窗口按投标假设编制并在 30 日内提交书面确认；分层质量文件时点表、独立复核与抽样计划、质保更换追溯台账作为合同义务；已披露投标假设（货源与交期书面确认、专项系统规格与接口覆盖确认、买方付款节点与账期）作为供货方在约定期限内提交、由买方审查确认的后续履约义务，不视为已完成事实。报价 16,020,000 MOP、币种 MOP、范围边界、成员 COMP-0167、资源占用 0.25 均未改变。双方均可自由拒绝本稿。

本投标以单一责任供应商身份承担主体结构与土建工程包的材料供货，范围严格限定为：结构主材与土建辅材的供货、运输到场、质量证明文件提交及质保期内更换，不含任何施工、安装、临时工程或措施费，亦不承担施工界面责任。

**供货范围与分项**：按结构主材（钢筋、型钢、混凝土预制构件、结构预埋件）与土建辅材（砌体、屋面找平材料、止水与防水辅材、模板料具等）分项列示，报价按材料范围清单分项编制。

**质量证明文件**：随每批到场材料提交出厂合格证、材质检验报告、第三方复检报告（按抽样计划）、来源可追溯声明及环保合规声明；由质量经理林嘉怡牵头建立提交清单与独立复核安排，技术协调经理何俊杰负责规格与设计文件一致性核对口径。

**安装接口信息**：仅提供材料规格、预埋件定位参数等接口信息表供施工包使用，不承担安装责任。

**质保期更换**：质保期内非人为损坏的材料缺陷，承诺在收到通知后48小时内响应、7个工作日内完成更换或补供。

**备品备件计划**：按分项材料类别预留约1.5%的备品备件，随首批到场或按施工包需求分批交付。

**投标假设**：结构主材与土建辅材的分项货源锁定及分批到场节点尚未最终确认，本投标将其列为投标假设，报价按分项成本分解编制，并附材料价格指数联动调价条款。
bid_document.implementation_plan:
**供货方法与运输到场方案**：按主体结构、桩基与地下室、砌体、屋面找平的施工顺序，将供货分为三批框架（具体节点以施工包进度需求确认为准）：第一批为桩基与地下室结构主材及辅材，第二批为主体结构钢筋、型钢及预埋件，第三批为砌体、屋面找平及收尾辅材。运输采用平板车与厢式货车组合，按材料类别分线配送，到场前24小时通知施工包接收方，现场交接签认。

**质量证明文件提交清单与独立复核**：每批材料到场时同步提交质量证明文件包，由质量部门独立复核签字后移交施工包；抽样计划按材料类别与批次确定，复检报告在到场后5个工作日内补交。

**材料来源可追溯与环保合规声明**：每批材料附来源追溯码与环保合规声明，确保可追溯至生产批号。

**质保期更换与响应时限**：质保期内接到更换通知后48小时内响应，7个工作日内完成更换；紧急短缺情形下启动紧急调拨流程，由现场协调经理黄伟强对接施工包。

**价格基础与调整机制**：报价以当前材料价格指数1.11为基准，按分项成本分解编制；设材料价格指数联动调价条款，指数波动超过±5%时按约定公式调整，不写成固定总价。

**进度视图**：附材料到场节点清单与三批框架进度视图，具体节点待施工包需求确认后锁定。
bid_document.schedule_commitment: 供货期与施工包主体结构进度匹配，按三批框架安排：第一批桩基与地下室材料在合同生效后按施工包需求启动；第二批主体结构材料按结构施工节奏分批到场；第三批砌体与屋面找平材料随收尾进度交付。具体到场节点以施工包进度需求确认为准，本投标列为投标假设。质保期自最后一批材料验收合格起算，按合同约定执行。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: Supplier COMP-0167 remains the single responsible supplier for package CASE-0206/supply-1: supply, transport to site, submission of quality certification documents and warranty-period replacement of structural main materials (rebar, section steel, precast structural components, structural embedments) and civil auxiliary materials (masonry, roof screed materials, waterproofing and waterstop auxiliaries, formwork materials). Excluded: any construction, installation, temporary works or measure costs, and any construction-interface responsibility. Interface information (material specifications, embedment positioning parameters) is provided by the supplier as an information table for the construction package's use only; it creates no installation obligation. The supplier locks the sub-item sources of structural and civil materials itself before supply and bears the associated risk; the sub-item cost breakdown is attached to the contract solely as supporting documentation for the fixed price and is not a basis for price adjustment. The supplier's disclosed bid assumptions on source locking and batch arrival nodes are accepted as stated risk allocations to the supplier, not as conditions precedent to signing.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: Contract price is a fixed lump sum of MOP 18,080,000 (Macao Patacas eighteen million eighty thousand), covering all supply, transport to site, quality certification document submission and warranty-period replacement costs, excluding construction, installation, temporary works and measure costs. No material price index linkage adjustment clause applies; the bid's index-1.11-based adjustment wording and price-volatility buffer clause are not incorporated, and the fixed lump sum does not adjust during the contract term for material price fluctuation. No uncapped price adjustment is added to the authorized scope; any request for index linkage or other price adjustment remains unresolved and would require re-tendering. No out-of-scope additions are accepted; the supplier's no-out-of-scope-additions position is accepted as a binding obligation. The buyer's decision on price basis is final for this draft: fixed lump sum, no index linkage.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment is made in installments against acceptance of each delivered material batch. The buyer completes acceptance confirmation within 10 working days after each batch arrives on site; payment for an accepted batch follows that confirmation. A batch whose third-party re-inspection fails is suspended from use, and re-inspection and replacement costs for that batch are borne by the supplier. No payment is due for a batch until it passes acceptance, including quality document verification.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Supply follows a three-batch framework: batch 1 pile foundation and basement materials; batch 2 main structure materials; batch 3 masonry, roof screed and finishing auxiliary materials. Specific arrival nodes are provided by the construction package as progress requirements after contract effectiveness and are locked upon written confirmation by both parties; before confirmation the supplier schedules production under the three-batch framework, and after confirmation the locked nodes govern. Locked nodes are a supply-plan obligation and not a price-adjustment event. For each batch, the supplier submits at arrival the factory certificate, material inspection report and source-traceability statement; the third-party re-inspection report is supplemented within 5 working days after arrival; documents are released to the construction package only after independent review and signature by the quality department. Warranty runs from acceptance of the last batch. During warranty, the supplier responds within 48 hours of a replacement notice and completes replacement or supplementary supply within 7 working days for non-human-caused material defects; spare parts of approximately 1.5% are reserved by material category and delivered with the first batch or in batches per construction-package demand.
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: Buyer COMP-0153 feedback is adopted as binding: fixed lump sum MOP 18,080,000; no index linkage; supplier locks sources and bears that risk; batch nodes are a supply obligation; quality documents and warranty replacement (48-hour response, 7-working-day replacement, approximately 1.5% spares) remain contract obligations. Bidder COMP-0167 feedback is partly adopted and partly rejected: the batch-node confirmation mechanism, quality-document deadlines, re-inspection cost allocation and 10-working-day buyer acceptance are adopted; the requested index-linkage formula P_adj = P_base x (I_current / 1.11 - 1) is rejected and remains unresolved, requiring re-tendering if pursued. The bidder's position that source locking and batch nodes are disclosed assumptions is accepted as a risk allocation to the supplier, not as a condition precedent. Price, currency, scope boundaries, parties, work shares and resource commitments are unchanged. Each party remains free to reject this draft.

三、质量风险：按材料类别分层提交质量证明文件，进场前独立复核并执行抽样计划，质保更换纳入同一追溯台账。

negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: 供货方 COMP-0167 以单一供货方身份，按原投标范围供应 CASE-0206/supply-2 全部材料与构配件：给排水与消防管线材料、暖通设备与风管构配件、强弱电桥架与线缆、电梯与厨房洗衣房设备接口材料、客房控制系统及酒店运营专项系统配套材料；负责供货、运输到场、与买方 COMP-0191 现场人员办理交接签认（仅限数量与外观）、提交质量证明文件、质保期内更换与备品备件支持。不含施工、安装、调试、临时工程与措施费，不承担施工界面责任。供货方在合同生效后 30 日内提交规格响应表，逐项列明品牌、型号、材质、压力等级、接口参数与适用标准；酒店专项系统材料技术规格与接口信息未书面确认部分，供货方应在合同生效后 30 日内提交规格响应确认或替代方案报批，未经买方书面确认的规格不得作为供货依据，亦不构成买方接受。供货方仅提供材料与主体结构预留孔洞接驳所需信息核对，不承担接驳施工。
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: 合同价固定为 16,020,000 MOP，币种 MOP，价格构成按投标分项（材料本体费 12,680,000；运输到场与现场交接费 620,000；质量证明文件与追溯管理费 385,000；质保期更换与备品备件支持费 540,000；价格波动风险缓冲 760,000；买方账期回款风险缓冲 310,000；管理与合规成本及合理利润 725,000）。价格调整以材料价格指数为基准，基准值取 1.11，触发阈值设为基准值的正负 3%（即指数高于 1.1333 或低于 1.0667 时触发）；超出阈值部分按公式调整额等于合同价中材料本体费 12,680,000 乘以（当期指数减基准值再减阈值幅度）除以基准值计算，仅对超出阈值部分调整，且累计调整额上限为价格波动风险缓冲 760,000 MOP，不设其他无上限调价。供货方应在指数触发后 10 个工作日内向买方书面申报并附指数来源证明，买方在收到后 10 个工作日内核定；逾期申报视为放弃该期调整。报价有效期与价格锁定方式按投标文件表述执行，不写成已锁定固定价。上述价格、币种、范围、成员与资源不变；如后续要求超出本条约定的调价机制，属未解决事项，需重新招标。
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: 买方 COMP-0191 按施工包进度节点分期支付，账期三十日；每期付款以对应批次质量证明文件经买方审查通过为付款条件。质保金按合同价 5%（801,000 MOP）预留，质保期满且无未处理更换事项后支付。付款节点与账期以本条为准，不再以待核实状态处理。
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: 供货方应在合同生效后 30 日内提交长交期机电设备与酒店专项系统材料的货源及到货窗口书面确认表，经买方书面核对后作为供货计划生效条件；逾期未提交或提交内容与施工包进度倒排不符的，买方有权暂停相应批次付款，并按合同约定计取逾期违约金；连续逾期超过 60 日的，买方有权就该部分材料另行采购，差价由供货方承担。常规机电管线材料按批次滚动供货，供货计划以材料类别、批次、到场时点三列表达。质量证明文件随批次提交：机电管线与消防材料附合格证与检测报告，专项系统设备在发货前提交型式检验报告与接口参数表；进场前由供货方完成独立复核并执行抽样计划，复核不通过按退换与复检处置；质保更换完成后同步更新统一追溯台账。买方与业主方有权按合同约定进行质量证明文件审查、抽样复核与进度核对。
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: 已采纳买方 COMP-0191 的四项修订：长交期到货窗口 30 日先决条件及逾期暂停付款、违约金与另行采购差价条款；付款按施工包进度节点分期、账期三十日、质量文件审查为付款条件、5% 质保金；调价写明基准 1.11、阈值正负 3%、计算公式、申报与核定各 10 个工作日及缓冲上限 760,000 MOP；专项系统未确认规格 30 日内提交确认或替代方案报批，未经书面确认不得供货。已采纳供货方 COMP-0167 的立场：价格调整按指数机制执行且不写成已锁定固定价；长交期到货窗口按投标假设编制并在 30 日内提交书面确认；分层质量文件时点表、独立复核与抽样计划、质保更换追溯台账作为合同义务；已披露投标假设（货源与交期书面确认、专项系统规格与接口覆盖确认、买方付款节点与账期）作为供货方在约定期限内提交、由买方审查确认的后续履约义务，不视为已完成事实。报价 16,020,000 MOP、币种 MOP、范围边界、成员 COMP-0167、资源占用 0.25 均未改变。双方均可自由拒绝本稿。
